title: Freelance / 1099 Total Cost Calculator
description: Calculates the true after-tax cost of freelance / 1099 work vs. W-2 employment. Applies SE tax (15.3% on 92.35% of net), self-employed health insurance deduction, SEP-IRA contribution limit, IRS mileage deduction, home office deduction, and 8-tier state effective rate lookup. Binary search algorithm finds the 1099 gross equivalent of any W-2 salary. Single-tab deterministic tool.
